inspiration: Nine-slice frames: one PNG per weight (thin, thick, panel) plus a headless panel with a smaller border (src/components/wowser/ui/frame/index.styl lines 23, 34, 44, 63). A cheap family of frames from one texture each.
A dark plate offset slightly outside each frame on a lower layer (frame/index.styl lines 10-19) gives contrast against bright scenes without a border colour.
Unit plate: a round icon overlapping the left edge of the plate, name to the right of it, level in the corner, a divider below (portrait/index.styl). Reads self and target in one glance.
HUD shows the target plate only when a target exists (src/components/game/hud/index.jsx lines 16-17). The default is empty and the UI grows with the fight.
Table-by-name joins: creature id to CreatureDisplayInfo to CreatureModelData (src/lib/game/unit.js lines 44-49). A clean chain for our catalogue (id, display, model) once we write our own rows.

Ordered content patch chain: archives listed in order, later patches overwrite earlier ones (src/lib/server/pipeline/archive.js lines 6-20). Our zones-as-data could use a base file plus overlays the same way.
